details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11031-11078 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted, the once-per-head guard (final_merge_auto_resumed_head_shas) is written only to the local STATE_FILE; it becomes durable only when `post_state_comment || true` runs at 11063, after the label changes, and a failure there is ignored.
  WHY: STATE_FILE is rebuilt from the state comment on every tick (15473-15474), so a cancellation or failed state post before the merge path posts state again (e.g. the budget-ineligible deferral at 17106-17109) lets the same head be retried, which breaks the once-per-head limit and the D4 "persist the guard first" claim. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it BLOCKER; the others rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10997-11001 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The resume head check requires the final PR's head to equal validation_last_passed_sha, but that field's only writer is mark_validation_complete (17091-17099), which a parked `failed` project never reaches, so a changed PR head can never become eligible again.
  WHY: Every tick after a head change logs `outcome=skip reason=validation_stale detail=head_mismatch` and then `Project already failed, skipping.`; this contradicts the tracking comment (~11067), README.md:249 and the changelog, which promise a retry once the head changes.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11050-11060 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: A failed `gh issue edit --remove-label "ai:needs-human"` is only warned about, the project moves to `validating`, and the cleanup is never attempted again; the fallback can also rebuild TRACKING_LABELS without ai:needs-human while the label is still on GitHub.
  WHY: The label stays on the issue and needs_human_digest_prune (23484-23513) keeps the stale digest entry. Severity disagreement: gemini and minimax rated it MAJOR, sonnet and luna NIT. glm rejected the finding as noise, saying set_tracking_phase_label "ai:validated" already removes ai:needs-human.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11050-11056 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The ai:needs-human removal block runs only when the tick-start TRACKING_LABELS snapshot contains the label, so a stale cache skips cleanup silently; the `::warning::` path also does not tell "label not present" apart from a real network failure.
  WHY: When the cache is stale, the block does nothing and the label stays on the issue; the terminal-state block is not re-entered later in the same tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11051-11056 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new `gh issue edit --remove-label "ai:needs-human"` call may be rejected by the gh_api_write_guard allowlist / PreToolUse hook.
  WHY: If the hook blocks the call, the resume fails or the label stays (only a warning is printed). Note: sonnet and glm explicitly rejected this as invalid, because the hook governs interactive sessions and the same call pattern already exists at 28962 / 15604 / 17190.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11078, 15452-15454, 15590-15608, 17149-17151, 17187-17189 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: At exhaustion, handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed "failed" marks the callback handled and removes ai:comprehensive-test-pending; the auto-resume restores neither, so after a successful resumed merge the "complete" callback returns early and the verifying run is never dispatched (luna adds that a verifying project can bypass the label-gated promotion gate at 14947-56).
  WHY: A comprehensive project completes without its verifying run or promotion, which contradicts "every existing gate still applies". Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT (noting it matches the pre-existing manual-merge behaviour, so it is not a regression); the others rated it MAJOR.
- README.md:249 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED row documents `ai:force-merge` as a recovery path, but maybe_apply_force_merge_bypass requires project_is_validation_origin_terminal_failure (10616-10629), and a final-merge-exhausted park carries `ai:blocked`, not validation-origin labels.
  WHY: An operator who disables the switch and applies `ai:force-merge` gets no bypass, and the project stays parked with `Project already failed, skipping.`
- agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md:5 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The contractual detail list `detail=<state|pr|head_ref_mismatch|checks|compare|state_write|missing|head_mismatch>` leaves out `labels`, which the code emits at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10962 (`lookup_failed detail=labels`).
  WHY: Log consumers that validate against the registered set will see an unregistered detail value (stable-log contract drift).
- agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md:5 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The agents fragment registers validation_stale, which was never part of the documented contract for the FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME prefix.
  WHY: Log consumers that parse against the documented set will treat validation_stale as unknown.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10970-10971, 10998-10999 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The code emits reason=validation_stale, which is outside the mandated reason set for the FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME log prefix.
  WHY: Log parsers that expect only the documented reason set will treat it as an undocumented error state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (and tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py):CI gate .github/workflows/ci.yml:434-456 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate on head fc5fd22b reports a ShellCheck error-severity failure and a timeout in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, so none of the ten new test_final_merge_auto_resume_* tests has been observed to pass.
  WHY: The failing shellcheck gate blocks merge and the core behaviour is unverified; the failure could not be mapped to a specific hunk. Note: sonnet rejected the shellcheck claim, saying only the copilot reviewer check failed on fc5fd22.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Stop after one try per head SHA. Record each final-PR head SHA that has had an automatic retry. If the retry fails again, the project re-parks normally, and no further automatic retry happens until the PR's head changes."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted (head_mismatch gate at 10998-11001), plus a head-change test in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The head is recorded in final_merge_auto_resumed_head_shas (~11039), but the gate compares against validation_last_passed_sha, whose only writer is mark_validation_complete (17091-17099 / 17094, confirmed by repo-wide grep); the terminal failed-state path skips the project (29006-12), so a new head never qualifies; no test covers a head change after a re-park (test_final_merge_auto_resume_refailed_merge_counts_attempts_then_reparks_once_per_head / test_final_merge_auto_resume_runs_once_per_head_sha cover only the same-head skip); the tracking comment (11067), README row and changelog promise the opposite; either implement the re-arm or document the narrowing.
- requirement: "outcome=skip, with reason= one of disabled, not_final_merge_exhausted, pr_not_open, not_mergeable, checks_not_green, already_resumed_on_head, lookup_failed, not_ahead."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted (lines 10970-71 / 10974 and 10998-99), and agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md line 5
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The code emits `reason=validation_stale detail=missing` (10971) and `reason=validation_stale detail=head_mismatch` (10999), outside the closed set; the agents fragment registers it; no hunk removes either; suggested fix: map it to `lookup_failed detail=validation_stale` or accept it as a spec extension (`lookup_failed detail=state_write` at 11044 is arguably within the set).
- requirement: "an `agents.d/` fragment describing the switch and the logging prefix", with the prefix's `detail=` enumeration matching what the code emits.
  expected_change_site: agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md line 5
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment lists `detail=<state|pr|head_ref_mismatch|checks|compare|state_write|missing|head_mismatch>` but the code emits `detail=labels` at line 10962 (`resume_label_park` lookup failure).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted head check (about lines 10998-11001); validation_last_passed_sha written only in mark_validation_complete (lines 17091-17099) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The resume requires the PR head to equal validation_last_passed_sha, which nothing updates while the project is parked, so after a head change the project never becomes eligible again; the tracking comment (about line 11067), README and changelog promise the opposite.
  WHY: Every tick logs `outcome=skip reason=validation_stale detail=head_mismatch` then `Project already failed, skipping.`; fix: either reword the docs and comment to require `/judge_resume` plus revalidation, or allow a new head and let the validation-history gate decide.
- README.md:249 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The row's `ai:force-merge` recovery does not apply: maybe_apply_force_merge_bypass (lines 28997-28998) runs only when project_is_validation_origin_terminal_failure (lines 10616-10629) is true, and this park carries `ai:blocked`.
  WHY: An operator who applies `ai:force-merge` gets no bypass; replace the text with "merges by hand or runs `/judge_resume`".
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted jq guard write (about lines 11034-11041), `post_state_comment || true` (about line 11063), mark_validation_complete (line 11078) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The guard sits only in the local STATE_FILE until post_state_comment runs after the label mutations, and its failure is ignored (it returns 1 on pack/manifest/chunk failures, lines 3557-3616); the budget-ineligible deferral returns at 17106-17109 without posting state.
  WHY: A failed post or a cancellation reloads the old `failed` state with no guard, so the same head is retried and posts another comment; fix: post_state_comment right after the jq write, and on failure emit `outcome=skip reason=lookup_failed detail=state_write` and return 1.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:ai:needs-human removal (about lines 11051-11055) plus TRACKING_LABELS fallback rebuild | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed removal is only warned about
